notes.title: Moving Out 2 | Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
[b]Listen up F.A.R.T's, stretch those muscles, fuel up the Smooth Moves van and get ready to move out as we have some major news to reveal today! - [u]Moving Out 2 now has a release date![/u][/b]

Moving Out 2, the sequel to the 2020 award-winning couch-moving, couch co-op game from SMG Studio and DevM Games is...

[h2]Launching on August 15th 2023![/h2]

[b]Unpack the news in our Release Date Announcement trailer! 
[/b]
[previewyoutube=BfaDFovJ_2M;full][/previewyoutube]
That's right! We're just under 2 months away from when you can become an Official F.A.R.T. and experience all the new bells and whistles and Online play that we are bringing to Moving Out 2.

If August feels like it's too long of a time to way, don't fret, as you will be able to try out Moving Out 2 yourselves from the [b]19th of June when the Moving Out 2 Next Fest Demo goes live![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42849904/374271517b4a4798a88fa3cf57781b655207061a.png[/img]

Not able to play the demo? No worries! Smooth Moves has you covered - We've enlisted the help of Team17's finest F.A.R.T's to showcase the demo in all its glory in an upcoming [url=https://twitch.tv/Team17][u]Team17 Twitch live stream[/u][/url] - We'll make sure to share the details ASAP!

[url=https://discord.gg/qwD6HBMhru][u][b]Click this link to get on board the Smooth Moves Van on its destination to our official Discord server![/b][/u][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34085797/3cdb10ed146028163e872a5d71fdcf4f75dcfb61.png[/img]

notes.title: Moving Out - Update 1.2 Available Now!
notes.notes:
Hello F.A.R.Ts!

Update 1.2 is now available for Moving Out on all platforms!

[previewyoutube=fkzbZRmLv48;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]New Mover:[/b] Meet T.Pott! When the heat is on and the pressure builds, it's T.Pott's time to shine!

[b]Platinum Times & Medals:[/b] If you've beaten all gold times then this is the challenge for you!

[b]It's time to dance:[/b] We've added four new dance moves for you to perform AND a fun new feature we're calling 'Disco Detector'...


We've also addressed a few issues (including the trophies/achievements that wouldn't unlock), squashed some bugs, and made a few quality of life adjustments!


See the full patch notes below...

[list]
[*] General bug fixes & improvements - including a fix for achievements/trophies that would not unlock
[*] Added ‘Disco Detector’ - Disco ball appears when all players dance at the same time
[*] Added additional controller layout options
[*] Added Platinum Times and Medals for base game levels
[*] Added a new character: T. Pott
[*] Updated text and localisations
[*] Added best times visibility for all player counts on the level results screen
[*] Added four new dances for the movers to perform
[/list]

notes.title: Moving Out – Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Grab your co-op buddies, we’ll be Moving Out on April 28th![/b][/h2]

[previewyoutube=9lIEghdJQUI;full][/previewyoutube]

In Moving Out, you’ll be relocating furnishings in increasingly bizarre locations in a fast-paced furniture moving simulator that brings a whole new meaning to ‘couch co-op’!

[h3]Features[/h3]
[b]Character Customisation.[/b] Choose from a roster of movers and style them to suit you. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34085797/fc701c66fb138396b3772a4e1dddf23eeb18e838.jpg[/img]

[b]Assist Mode.[/b] Increased time limits, skippable levels and removal of dangers are just some of the options available in assist mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34085797/76129d73282e8790f548cb1e7a64e18fa3341098.jpg[/img]

[b]Accessibility Options.[/b] Dyslexia friendly mode, scalable user interface, multiple controller mappings (Steam has fully remappable controls) and subtitles have all been implemented in game to make the experience as inclusive as possible.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34085797/89318b512a5a29862c0f96bc9e90734ae0a2aba5.jpg[/img]

[b]Local co-op.[/b] Players can either take on Moving Out solo or enlist the help of up to three friends as they figure out the quickest way to get a CRT TV to the bottom of a double-storey building without breaking it. Steam players will also be able to utilise the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/remoteplay#together]Steam Remote Play Together[/url] features to play with their friends over the internet! 

[b]Location, location, location.[/b] No move is too big, too small, or too weird. Move through sleepy suburbs, frenzied farms, haunted houses and even head into space to keep customers happy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34085797/89910777cb82510829bbbe894ec4df5364e47df1.jpg[/img]

[b]Physics.[/b] Need to get a large item of furniture down some steps? Gravity is your friend! Glass door in your way? Smash right through it! Throwing things over railings will always be quicker than carrying them the long way around.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WyzbAB4.gif[/img]

Moving Out comes to Steam on April 28th 2020!
